name: Campingplatz Maier Schwoich
beschreibung: The Maier campsite is located in the quiet municipality of Schwoich in the Tiroler Unterland, near the town of Kufstein. The surroundings are characterized by the mountain backdrop of the Kaisergebirge and the Brandenberger Alpen. Guests use the location for hiking and cycling in summer. In winter, the Wilder Kaiser ski areas and Kufstein are easily accessible. The facility offers pitches for various vehicle types as well as sanitary facilities. A restaurant and a playground are available on the grounds. The campsite is family-run and offers a quiet atmosphere. The nearby Kufstein train station makes it possible to arrive without a car.
